tp.einheit.kopfballpendel.name: Heading pendulum
tp.einheit.kopfballpendel.text: The ball hangs on a cord and the lads jump and head it in rhythm. It trains timing, leap and nerve in the air.
tp.einheit.freistoesse.name: Free-kick practice
tp.einheit.freistoesse.text: Build the wall, place the ball, shot after shot. Patience here means more goals over the wall on Saturday.
tp.einheit.eckenvariationen.name: Corner routines
tp.einheit.eckenvariationen.text: We practise corners short and long, near post and far post. It is all about the flight of the ball and the runs.
tp.einheit.elfmeterschiessen.name: Penalty shoot-out
tp.einheit.elfmeterschiessen.text: One against the keeper, with the pressure on. Whoever keeps his nerve here will do it in a match too.
tp.einheit.fluegelspiel.name: Crossing drills
tp.einheit.fluegelspiel.text: Break down the wing, play it short, cross it in. The focus is on pace and an accurate delivery.
tp.einheit.torschuss.name: Shooting practice
tp.einheit.torschuss.text: Shots from every angle with a defender on the back. What matters is the ball arriving low and hard.
tp.einheit.passspiel.name: Passing drills
tp.einheit.passspiel.text: Short triangles, quick circulation, one touch. Whoever is clean here keeps the ball under pressure.
tp.einheit.dribbling.name: Dribbling skills
tp.einheit.dribbling.text: Slalom, changes of direction, stepovers. A session for a player who should get even surer with the ball at his feet.
tp.einheit.zweikampf.name: Duels and tackling
tp.einheit.zweikampf.text: Man against man, body in, win the ball. It is hard on the bones, so not too often in a row.
tp.einheit.defensivarbeit.name: Defensive work
tp.einheit.defensivarbeit.text: The back line shifts, we close the spaces and practise cutting off the passing lanes.
tp.einheit.ausdauerlauf.name: Endurance run
tp.einheit.ausdauerlauf.text: Laps around the pitch and intervals. It hurts, but it makes the last twenty minutes strong. Spirits dip after a day like this.
tp.einheit.schnelligkeit.name: Speed work
tp.einheit.schnelligkeit.text: Short sprints, bursts from standing, ladders and hurdles. If you want to get quick, you have to graft.
tp.einheit.torwarttraining.name: Goalkeeper training
tp.einheit.torwarttraining.text: The keepers work on their own: catching crosses, reflexes, rushing out. A good goalkeeping coach helps a lot.
tp.einheit.spielaufbau.name: Build-up play
tp.einheit.spielaufbau.text: Playing out from the back, opening spaces, finding the middle. We practise getting the ball forward safely.
tp.einheit.taktikschulung.name: Tactics session
tp.einheit.taktikschulung.text: We walk through who runs where on the tactics board and replay it in slow motion. Hardly any strain, plenty of thinking.
tp.einheit.spezialtraining.name: Special skill training
tp.einheit.spezialtraining.text: One player works on a special strength. It takes time and patience, but it comes over the weeks.
tp.einheit.regeneration.name: Recovery
tp.einheit.regeneration.text: Jogging out, stretching, ice bath. The legs get light again and the risk drops.
tp.einheit.reha.name: Rehab session
tp.einheit.reha.text: Gentle build-up work for players with knocks, supervised by the physio.
tp.vorlage.standard.name: Standard week
tp.vorlage.standard.text: A balanced week with a match on Saturday, a rest day in the middle and a loose cool-down on Sunday.
tp.vorlage.vorbereitung.name: Pre-season week
tp.vorlage.vorbereitung.text: Plenty of endurance and pace plus tactics. A hard week that you should not run every week.
tp.vorlage.spielwoche_liga.name: League match week
tp.vorlage.spielwoche_liga.text: Recover on Monday, train close to match play, only set pieces on Friday. Saturday is match day.
tp.vorlage.spielwoche_pokal.name: Cup match week
tp.vorlage.spielwoche_pokal.text: Cup tie on Wednesday, league match on Saturday: we save energy and train lightly.
tp.vorlage.regenerationswoche.name: Recovery week
tp.vorlage.regenerationswoche.text: Feet up. Little strain, lots of rest so the batteries fill up again.
tp.vorlage.intensivwoche.name: Intensive week
tp.vorlage.intensivwoche.text: Three sessions on some days, high tempo, hard duels. It brings gains, but the risk rises.
tp.vorlage.jugendfokus.name: Youth focus
tp.vorlage.jugendfokus.text: Plenty of technique and one-to-one work for the young players, plus a match at the weekend.
tp.ampel.gruen: The week is easy on the squad.
tp.ampel.gelb: The week gets tough, a few players run hot.
tp.ampel.rot: Too much at once: the injury danger climbs sharply.
tp.zone.normal: The load is in the comfortable range.
tp.zone.ueberlastet: The squad is at its limit.
tp.moral.plus: The lads go into training in a good mood.
tp.hinweis.belastung_gelb: One more rest day or a lighter pace keeps the squad fresher.
tp.hinweis.belastung_rot: Drop some sessions or add a recovery day, otherwise players will soon drop out.
tp.hinweis.einzel_leer: The one-to-one slot still needs a player, nobody trains there yet.
tp.hinweis.kein_spiel: No match day is set for this week.
tp.fehler.name: Give the week a name first.
tp.fehler.plan: That does not fit into the week. There is no room for it on that day.
tp.ok.geladen: The week is open on the desk.
tp.ok.geloescht: The plan has been taken out of the folder.
tp.ok.uebernommen: The coaching staff has the weekly plan and is getting ready.
tp.ui.name: Name of the plan
tp.ui.intro: Drag a session into a slot of the week, or click the session first and then the slot.
tp.einheit.umschulung.name: Retraining
tp.einheit.umschulung.text: A player learns a new position: runs, spacing and decisions in training, week after week. It costs energy and takes patience.
tp.fehler.platz: No single-session slot is free this week. Make room on a training day.
tp.fehler.weg: That special ability is not an option for him right now.
tp.fehler.mentor: The mentor cannot pass that on right now.
tp.fehler.umschulung: That player is not in the squad.
tp.trainer.schwach: The coaching staff is thin, which holds back every session.
tp.trainer.solide: The coaching staff does solid work.
tp.trainer.stark: The coaching staff gets a little more out of every session.
tp.trainer.unbekannt: The coaching staff is still settling in.
tp.spezial.grund.voll: Ten special abilities is the maximum, and none is weaker than this one.
tp.ok.spezial: %1 now trains towards “%2”. Confirm the week so the staff picks it up.
tp.ok.spezial_weg: %1 no longer trains a special ability.
tp.ok.umschulung: %1 will be retrained as %2 (%3 weeks). Confirm the week to get started.
tp.vg.umschulung.kopf: %1 has made the switch from %2 to %3.
tp.vg.umschulung.fuss: In the line-up and for the assistant coach, %1 now counts as a full position.
tp.vg.mentor.kopf.nein: %2 could not pass the special ability “%3” on to %1.
tp.vg.mentor.zeile.kein_erfolg: %1 did not learn “%2”, it was not enough.
tp.vg.mentor.zeile.voll: %1 already has ten special abilities, “%2” found no room.
tp.bericht.titel: Training report %1: what did training bring?
tp.bericht.kopf: This week's training moved something for %1 players, %2 points in total.
tp.ui.spezial.intro: Pick the special ability a player trains towards. Only abilities the game knows and that suit him are offered.
tp.ui.spezial.leer: The coaching staff does not know any special drills yet. Once some are cleared, they show up here.
tp.ui.spezial.mentor_laeuft: The mentor is passing on “%1”, result on %2.
tp.ui.um.intro: The assistant coach suggests players who are needed elsewhere. Add one to the week as a training goal and he trains for the new position.
tp.ui.um.geplant: In the plan, not started yet
tp.ui.um.keine: Nobody is being retrained right now.
tp.ui.leer_seite: The coaching staff is still planning. The week will be here in a moment.
tp.ui.nicht_hier: There is no room for that there.
